review: 209.2-1: libraries were empty, so the other_walker_activated variant's Jace +2 (each player draws) would make both players lose to 704.5b; gave each player a two-card library, and put 3 loyalty counters on both planeswalkers explicitly.

scenarios.title: A planeswalker enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty
decisions: A casts Liliana of the Veil, tapping three Swamps.
B passes priority; Liliana of the Veil resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Liliana of the Veil enters the battlefield with 3 loyalty counters, her printed loyalty.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Liliana of the Veil is countered and moves to A's graveyard; she never enters the battlefield, so no loyalty counters are placed.

scenarios.title: A loyalty ability is playable only at sorcery timing and once per permanent per turn

setup.notes: A has priority with an empty stack, and neither planeswalker has had a loyalty ability activated this turn.

decisions: The engine is asked whether A can activate Liliana of the Veil's +1 with the current priority and stack.

variants.label: already_activated
variants.delta: Earlier this turn A activated Liliana's +1 and it resolved.
variants.expected: Activating Liliana's +1 again is not legal, because one of her loyalty abilities was already activated this turn.

operation.unclassifiable: A prior loyalty activation earlier in the turn; game history, not board state.

variants.label: other_walker_activated
variants.delta: Earlier this turn A activated Jace Beleren's +2 and it resolved.
variants.expected: Activating Liliana's +1 is legal, since only the activating permanent's own earlier activations count.

operation.unclassifiable: A prior activation of a different permanent; game history.

variants.label: opponent_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player and it is B's main phase; A has priority.
variants.expected: Activating Liliana's +1 is not legal, because it is not A's turn.

operation.unclassifiable: Changes the turn and active player.

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: The step is beginning of combat instead of main phase.
variants.expected: Activating Liliana's +1 is not legal, because it is not a main phase.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A has cast Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain, and it is still on the stack.
variants.expected: Activating Liliana's +1 is not legal, because the stack is not empty.

operation.unclassifiable: A different spell is cast and remains on the stack.

detector.outcome: An activated ability candidate restricted to sorcery timing has timing legal: a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack.
detector.near_miss: A candidate in another step, on another player's turn or with a non-empty stack has timing false.
